repository.name: aviunion1348-cloud/rag-formation
repository.working_tree_status: tracked files clean during every recording (checked by the harness before each scenario); untracked: artifacts/agent_session_recordings/ (the outputs being written)

environment.architecture: x86_64 · 2 vCPU · 3939 MiB RAM · no GPU · no display server
environment.application_version: ragformation 0.2.0 · Lear agent CLI `python3 -m ragformation lear`
environment.evidence: evidence/preflight.json checks E01, E06, E07; evidence/env/

llm.reason: Ollama binary absent, server unreachable, release assets and model registries unreachable from this sandbox (preflight O01-O11)
llm.used_in_recordings: extractive:extractive-synthesis-v1, the labelled baseline that selects and cites corpus sentences; NOT an LLM

embedding.used_in_recordings: hashing:hashing-lexical-v1 (512-d, L2-normalised; lexical baseline, not semantic)

providers.vector_store: SQLite ragformation.db: vectors table (exact brute-force cosine in Python) + FTS5 chunks_fts (BM25)
providers.reranker: heuristic-coverage-v1 (rule-based support score; not a model), then MMR (lambda 0.72)
providers.memory: SQLite agent.db: sessions, messages, compactions (lear-compaction-v1 summaries), memories (scoped long-term memory)

recording_tool: asciinema 2.4.0 (asciicast v2, real timing, no idle-time limit) inside util-linux script 2.38.1; MP4 rendered by scripts/session_recordings/render_cast.py (pyte 0.8.2, Pillow 13.0.0, ffmpeg n9.0.2, libx264)
video_format: 1920x1080 H.264 High yuv420p 15 fps, no audio; part 1 real-time playback, part 2 paced replay of the same recording (pauses labelled HELD FOR READING; the banner always shows the true recorded clock)
